nl: An export job is running and will create data/export.csv within a few seconds. Wait until the file exists, then copy it to backup/export-5.csv.

entries.content_utf8:
import os
import pathlib
import sys
import time

time.sleep(1.5)
pathlib.Path("data").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
pathlib.Path("data/export.tmp").write_text(sys.argv[2])
os.replace("data/export.tmp", "data/export.csv")
